added_failure_basis: the reviewed run records baseline_suite and after_suite both null and test_logs 'none', so no arm delta could be derived; the zero records the absence of arms, not a measured clean delta. The reviewer's own re-run of the single named test failed at tests/test_mast_centroid_panel_states.py:84 (EXIT=1).

findings.text: the gate test reads committed["drawn_plasma_mesh"]["vacuum_nulls"], but the delivered receipts no longer carry drawn_plasma_mesh (grep -c returns 0 in all three), so the node's own gate raises KeyError and fails before drawing anything; reproduced with EXIT=1.

the fragment asserts "Each rendered SVG is converted to PNG and inspected; the labels check reports zero clipped and zero overlapping labels", while its own landing at line 55 says no SVG was rendered and the PNG inspection "has not run"; the document claims a measurement that did not occur.

the receipt carries no invocation block, although plan section 6 requires the full command in the new receipt and the producer at that receipt's own source_revision (c09f65352) writes one; the titan and full-axis receipts are the same, so the three files are not the direct output of the producer they name.
no map spacing is recorded in any receipt, though done_when (2) requires each re-solved receipt to record the map spacing of 10 mm or finer; the receipt schema has no spacing field at all.

_lattice_spline and _polish re-implement, on a scipy RectBivariateSpline, the stationary-point polish the repository already owns at nova/equilibrium/display_flux.py:143 via nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_connectivity.py:916 and nova.linalg.tensor_spline.fit_tensor_spline; the two splines need not agree on the saddle the display map reports.
_PanelOperator.raster_image restates the moment contraction that nova/equilibrium/display_flux.py:125 (_flux) already owns instead of calling it.

assert np.any(offsets > 1.0e-6) is satisfied by a lattice-raster contour too, because contour vertices lie on cell edges between lattice rows, so the assertion does not exclude the raster it was added to exclude.

panels keeps boundary_flux from the state for the contour level array while the drawn separatrix branches now come from the display map at the map's own saddle flux, so the boundary is one of the drawn contours only when the two levels coincide, which the comment at line 1302 assumes and nothing asserts

the coupling returns zero radial and vertical plasma moment columns for every point set, which is exact only because the committed states carry exactly zero such moments, and it makes display.reproduction_relative_error a comparison of the map against a raster built from the same coupling, so that figure is near zero by construction and cannot detect a defect in the display evaluation
